title: What Smart Dust Networks 2.0 Is
definition: Smart Dust Networks 2.0: next-gen dust-mote sensors everywhere.
description:
Smart Dust Networks 2.0: next-gen dust-mote sensors everywhere. This is Future Materials at its most ambitious — mote nodes research, network logistics engineering and energy harvesting operations converging on a single goal: making network hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Materials will decide mesh protocols outcomes this century. Smart Dust Networks 2.0 is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working network hulls, the larger mote nodes vision stalls, and with it, the network logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Smart Dust Networks 2.0 in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Readiness Estimator: Smart Dust Networks 2.0
definition: Estimates Smart Dust Networks 2.0 readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Smart Dust Networks 2.0 components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a network hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Smart Dust Networks 2.0 Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Smart Dust Networks 2.0 operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Smart Dust Networks 2.0 installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 95340 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where mote nodes monitoring, network logistics redundancy, or energy harvesting maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Smart Dust Networks 2.0 Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Smart Dust Networks 2.0: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Smart Dust Networks 2.0 — next-gen dust-mote sensors everywhere.

Phase 1 — Prove (mote nodes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (network logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (energy harvesting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (mesh protocols): network hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and IoT-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
